# South China Morning Post

> > South China Morning Post (SCMP) is Asia's leading news media organization covering Hong Kong, China, and the Asian century with journalism, events, and digital experiences.

SCMP delivers authoritative news coverage and hosts premier business events including inclusion summits across Asia. The platform combines investigative journalism with leadership conferences focused on diversity, equity, and inclusion for corporate professionals and decision-makers.

## Key Topics

- Hong Kong
- Asia
- SCMP Live
- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)
- Inclusion Summits
- Business Leadership
- Asian Century
- Malaysia
- Corporate DEI
- Hybrid Conferences
- Social Impact
- DEI Professionals
- Manulife Partnership
- Kuala Lumpur

## Inclusion & Leadership Events

- [Hong Kong Inclusion Summit 2026](https://hkinclusionsummit.scmp.com/): Hong Kong Inclusion Summit 2026 at Ocean Park Marriott - DEI leadership event
- [Malaysia Inclusion Summit 2025](https://mis2025.scmp.com/): Malaysia Inclusion Summit 2025 at Westin KL - Manulife partnership DEI event
